records.literal_gloss: According to all the words the these and according to all the vision the this, so spoke Nathan to David.

en.L: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
en.B: Nathan spoke to David in keeping with all these words and all this vision.
en.R: Nathan told David everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said to him in this vision.

es.L: Conforme a todas estas palabras y conforme a toda esta visión, así habló Natán a David.
es.B: Natán le habló a David conforme a todas estas palabras y a toda esta visión.
es.R: Natán le contó a David todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dicho en esta visión.

fr.L: Selon toutes ces paroles et selon toute cette vision, ainsi Nathan parla à David.
fr.B: Nathan parla à David conformément à toutes ces paroles et à toute cette vision.
fr.R: Nathan a raconté à David tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait dit dans cette vision.

sw.L: Kwa maneno haya yote na kwa maono haya yote, ndivyo Nathani alivyomwambia Daudi.
sw.B: Nathani alimwambia Daudi sawasawa na maneno haya yote na maono haya yote.
sw.R: Nathani alimweleza Daudi kila kitu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia katika maono hayo.

vi.L: Theo mọi lời này và theo toàn bộ khải tượng này, Na-than đã nói lại với Đa-vít như vậy.
vi.B: Na-than thuật lại cho Đa-vít đúng như mọi lời này và toàn bộ khải tượng này.
vi.R: Na-than nói lại với Đa-vít mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với ông trong khải tượng này.

ko.L: 이 모든 말씀대로, 그리고 이 모든 환상대로, 나단이 다윗에게 그렇게 말했다.
ko.B: 나단은 이 모든 말씀과 이 모든 환상을 그대로 다윗에게 전했다.
ko.R: 나단은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 환상으로 하신 말씀을 모두 다윗에게 전했다.

pt.L: Conforme todas estas palavras e conforme toda esta visão, assim Natã falou a Davi.
pt.B: Natã falou a Davi de acordo com todas estas palavras e toda esta visão.
pt.R: Natã contou a Davi tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe tinha dito nessa visão.

decisions.choice: vision: a revelation given by God
decisions.reason: The word names a message seen or received from God. This one came at night (verse 3).

decisions.choice: so Nathan spoke: he passed on all of it
decisions.reason: Nathan told David everything, though it overturned his own word of approval (verse 2). The verse is the same as 2 Samuel 7:17.

decisions.choice: everything the LORD had said to him
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:17: Readable names the speaker behind "these words" (verse 4).

source.text: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִֽי־אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ וּמִ֣י בֵיתִ֔י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖נִי עַד־הֲלֹֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And went King David and sat before Yahweh and said, Who [am] I, Yahweh God, and who [is] my house, that you have brought me as far as here?

en.L: And King David went in and sat before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "Who [am] I, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, and what [is] my house, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have brought me this far?
en.B: Then King David went in and sat down before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, who am I, and what is my house, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have brought me as far as this?
en.R: Then King David went into the tent and sat down in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, who am I? And what is my family? Why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought me this far?

es.L: Y entró el rey David y se sentó delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y dijo: «¿Quién [soy] yo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, y qué [es] mi casa, para que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me hayas traído hasta aquí?
es.B: Entonces el rey David entró, se sentó delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, ¿quién soy yo, y qué es mi casa, para que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me hayas traído hasta aquí?
es.R: Entonces el rey David entró en la tienda y se sentó delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, ¿quién soy yo? ¿Y qué es mi familia? ¿Por qué me has traído {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hasta aquí?

fr.L: Et le roi David entra et s’assit devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et dit : « Qui [suis]-je, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, et qu’[est] ma maison, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’aies amené jusqu’ici ?
fr.B: Alors le roi David alla s’asseoir devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, qui suis-je, et qu’est-ce que ma maison, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’aies conduit jusque-là ?
fr.R: Ensuite le roi David est entré dans la tente et s’est assis devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, qui suis-je ? Et qu’est-ce que ma famille ? Pourquoi m’as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} conduit jusqu’ici ?

sw.L: Mfalme Daudi akaingia akaketi mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "Mimi [ni] nani, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, na nyumba yangu [ni] nini, hata {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umenileta mpaka hapa?
sw.B: Kisha mfalme Daudi aliingia akaketi mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, mimi ni nani, na nyumba yangu ni nini, hata {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umenifikisha hapa?
sw.R: Kisha mfalme Daudi aliingia hemani akaketi mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, mimi ni nani? Na jamaa yangu ni nini? Kwa nini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umenifikisha hapa?

vi.L: Vua Đa-vít đi vào, ngồi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thưa: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, con là ai, và nhà con là gì, mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem con đến mức này?
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua Đa-vít đi vào, ngồi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thưa: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, con là ai, và nhà con là gì, mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đưa con đến mức này?
vi.R: Rồi vua Đa-vít vào trong lều và ngồi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua thưa: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, con là ai? Gia đình con là gì? Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại đưa con đến mức này?

ko.L: 그러자 다윗 왕이 들어가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 앉아서 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 제가 누구[이며] 제 집이 무엇[이기에], 주님께서 저를 여기까지 이끌어 오셨습니까?
ko.B: 그러자 다윗 왕이 들어가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 앉아서 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 제가 누구이며 제 집안이 무엇이기에, 주님께서 저를 이렇게까지 이끌어 주셨습니까?
ko.R: 그러자 다윗 왕은 장막 안으로 들어가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 앉았다. 그가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 저는 누구입니까? 제 집안은 무엇입니까? 어찌하여 주님께서는 저를 여기까지 이끌어 주셨습니까?

pt.L: E o rei Davi entrou e se sentou diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e disse: "Quem [sou] eu, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, e o que [é] a minha casa, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me tenhas trazido até aqui?
pt.B: Então o rei Davi entrou, sentou-se diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e disse: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, quem sou eu, e o que é a minha casa, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me tenhas trazido até este ponto?
pt.R: Então o rei Davi entrou na tenda e se sentou diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele disse: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, quem sou eu? E o que é a minha família? Por que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me trouxeste até aqui?

decisions.choice: sat before Yahweh: in the tent where the ark was kept
decisions.reason: To be "before Yahweh" was to be in his presence at the sanctuary, here the tent David had set up for the ark in Jerusalem (16:1; verse 1). Sitting to pray is unusual; David sits as one at home in Yahweh's presence.

decisions.choice: Yahweh God: not "my Lord Yahweh"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:18-29 addresses Yahweh again and again as "my Lord Yahweh". Chronicles never uses that title here: it has "Yahweh God" (verses 16, 17), "God" (verse 17), "my God" (verse 25) or the name Yahweh alone (verses 19, 20, 22, 23, 26, 27). Otherwise this verse is the same as 2 Samuel 7:18.

decisions.choice: Who am I ...?: I am not worthy of this
decisions.reason: The question is a way of saying how small one is before a great gift or task (1 Samuel 18:18; Exodus 3:11).

decisions.choice: my house: my family
decisions.reason: Here David's house is his family, not the palace. He has just heard that Yahweh will build it into a house of kings (verse 10).

decisions.choice: LORD God (when David speaks to him)
decisions.reason: When the divine name is used to address Yahweh it is printed "LORD" without "the", as in 2 Samuel 7:24-25.

decisions.choice: went into the tent
decisions.reason: Readable says where David went (m1).

decisions.choice: SEÑOR Dios (vocative, without article)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Yahweh God" where 2 Samuel 7:18 has "Lord Yahweh"; the Spanish says "SEÑOR Dios", with the divine_name span on "SEÑOR" and no article in address, as the Kings drafts do.

decisions.choice: "SEIGNEUR Dieu"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Yahweh God" where 2 Samuel 7 has "my Lord Yahweh"; French follows the Hebrew, with the name addressed directly and without the article, as in 2 Samuel 7:25.

decisions.choice: Ee BWANA Mungu
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Yahweh God" where 2 Samuel 7:18 has "Lord Yahweh"; the Swahili says "BWANA Mungu", with the divine-name span on "BWANA", and the vocative "Ee".

decisions.choice: "Lạy CHÚA Đức Chúa Trời"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Yahweh God" where 2 Samuel has "Lord Yahweh", so the Vietnamese takes the form of 2 Samuel 7:25, "CHÚA Đức Chúa Trời". David prays with "con" and "Ngài", as in 2 Samuel 7.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님" for *YHWH Elohim*; David prays in 합쇼체, calling God "주님" and himself "저" and "주님의 종"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Yahweh God" where 2 Samuel 7:18 has "Lord GOD" (*Adonai YHWH*), so the Korean follows the Genesis note's wording for "the LORD God" (주 하나님, with the span on 주) rather than the Samuel note's wording for "Lord GOD" (주 하나님, with the span on 하나님).

decisions.choice: SENHOR Deus, without the article; tu
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Yahweh God" where 2 Samuel 7:18 has "my Lord Yahweh" (m2), so Portuguese says "SENHOR Deus" (the Old Testament terms for YHWH Elohim) instead of "Senhor DEUS", without the article in the vocative. David prays with "tu" throughout (verses 16-27), as in 2 Samuel 7, and the rest of the verse keeps its wording.

source.text: וַתִּקְטַ֨ן זֹ֤את בְּעֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר עַל־בֵּֽית־עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּרְאִיתַ֗נִי כְּת֧וֹר הָאָדָ֛ם הַֽמַּעֲלָ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And was small this in your eyes, O God, and you have spoken about [the] house of your servant for from far; and you have seen me according to [the] rank of the man of the ascent, Yahweh God.

en.L: And this was small in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes, God, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant's house for a distant [time], and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God.
en.B: And as if this were too little in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight, God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have also spoken about the house of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant far into the future. You have regarded me as a man of high rank, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God.
en.R: And as if that were not enough, God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have also made promises about my family for a long time to come. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have treated me as if I were a man of great importance.

es.L: Y esto fue poco a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos, oh Dios, y has hablado de la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo para tiempo lejano, y me has mirado conforme al rango de un hombre de alta posición, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios.
es.B: Y como si esto fuera poco a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos, oh Dios, también has hablado de la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo para un futuro lejano. Me has mirado como a un hombre de alto rango, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios.
es.R: Y como si eso fuera poco, oh Dios, también me has hecho promesas sobre mi familia para mucho tiempo por venir. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, me has tratado como si yo fuera un hombre muy importante.

fr.L: Et cela était peu de chose à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux, ô Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as parlé de la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur pour un [temps] lointain, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as regardé selon le rang d’un homme élevé, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu.
fr.B: Et comme si c’était encore trop peu à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux, ô Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as aussi parlé de la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur pour un avenir lointain. Tu m’as regardé comme un homme de haut rang, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu.
fr.R: Et comme si cela ne suffisait pas, ô Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as aussi fait des promesses pour ma famille, pour un long avenir. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as traité comme si j’étais un homme très important.

sw.L: Na hili lilikuwa dogo machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}, Ee Mungu, nawe umesema juu ya nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa [wakati] wa mbali, nawe umeniangalia kama cheo cha mtu wa hali ya juu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu.
sw.B: Na kana kwamba hili lilikuwa dogo machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}, Ee Mungu, umesema pia kuhusu nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa siku nyingi zijazo. Umeniangalia kama mtu wa cheo cha juu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu.
sw.R: Na kana kwamba hayo hayatoshi, Ee Mungu, umetoa pia ahadi kuhusu jamaa yangu kwa muda mrefu ujao. Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, umenitendea kana kwamba mimi ni mtu mkuu sana.

vi.L: Thế mà điều này vẫn còn là nhỏ trong mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về nhà của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho đến thời xa xăm, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhìn con như bậc người cao trọng, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Như thể điều này vẫn còn quá nhỏ trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại còn phán về nhà của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho đến tương lai lâu dài. Ngài đã đối đãi với con như một người có địa vị cao, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, như thể như vậy vẫn chưa đủ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn hứa về gia đình con cho đến muôn đời sau. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đối xử với con như thể con là một người rất quan trọng.

ko.L: 그런데 하나님, 이것도 주님의 눈에는 작은 일이어서, 주님께서 주님의 종의 집에 대해서도 먼 [앞날]까지 말씀하셨습니다. 그리고 주님께서 저를 높은 신분의 사람의 서열대로 보셨습니다, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님.
ko.B: 그런데 하나님, 주님께서는 이것도 작은 일로 여기셔서, 주님의 종의 집안에 대해서도 먼 앞날의 일까지 말씀해 주셨습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 주님께서는 저를 높은 사람처럼 대해 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 그것만으로도 크신 은혜인데, 주님께서는 제 집안에 대해서도 먼 앞날까지 약속해 주셨습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 주님께서는 저를 아주 중요한 사람처럼 대해 주셨습니다.

pt.L: E isto foi pouco aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos, ó Deus, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste da casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo para um [tempo] distante, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consideraste segundo a categoria de um homem de alta posição, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus.
pt.B: E, como se isso fosse pouco aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos, ó Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste também da casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo para um futuro distante. Tu me trataste como um homem de alta posição, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus.
pt.R: E, como se isso não bastasse, ó Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste também promessas sobre a minha família para muito tempo no futuro. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me trataste como se eu fosse um homem muito importante.

decisions.choice: this was small in your eyes: as if this were not enough for you
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:19. What God has done for David already is great, yet to God it was a small thing, and he has added more.

decisions.choice: for a distant time: far into the future
decisions.reason: "From far" can speak of distance in space or time. Here it is the future: God has spoken of David's house in the generations to come.

decisions.choice: you have regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree: you have treated me as a great man
alternatives: you have shown me the future generations of humankind
and this is the custom of humankind (2 Samuel 7:19)
decisions.reason: The words are hard to understand, and they differ from 2 Samuel 7:19, which has "and this is the law (or custom) of humankind". Word for word they say "you have seen me according to the turn (or order) of the man of the going up". The translation takes "order" as rank and "going up" as high standing: God has looked on David as one of the great. Others take the words as "you have shown me the generations of humankind to come", reading "going up" as onward in time and "seen me" as "made me see". The Hebrew may have suffered in copying, and no reading is certain.

decisions.choice: God; Yahweh God
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:19 has "my Lord Yahweh" twice; Chronicles has "God" and "Yahweh God" (verse 16).

decisions.choice: your servant: David himself
decisions.reason: Calling oneself "your servant" is a polite and humble way of saying "I" when speaking to a superior (1 Samuel 17:32). David uses it again and again in this prayer.

decisions.choice: your servant (Literal, Balanced); my family (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:19: "your servant" stays at every level as the polite form of address, and Readable often says "I", "me" or "my" instead, since the phrase is a polite way of saying "I".

decisions.choice: treated me as if I were a man of great importance
decisions.reason: Readable puts the reading taken in m3 in plain words; it carries the same uncertainty.

decisions.choice: umeniangalia kama cheo cha mtu wa hali ya juu (L); kama mtu wa cheo cha juu (B); kana kwamba mimi ni mtu mkuu sana (R)
alternatives: Je, hii ndiyo desturi ya wanadamu?
decisions.reason: Chronicles has a different and difficult line here from 2 Samuel 7:19; the Swahili follows the English reading of it, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: me consideraste segundo a categoria de um homem de alta posição (L); me trataste como um homem de alta posição (B, R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese follows the reading the meaning note takes for these hard words (m3), as the English does, and carries the same uncertainty. "O teu servo" (L, B) keeps the courtly third person of 2 Samuel 7:19 in Portuguese (m5), and "ó Deus" marks the vocative.

source.text: מַה־יּוֹסִ֨יף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛יד אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְכָב֣וֹד אֶת־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֥ יָדָֽעְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: What will add again David to you for [the] honor of your servant? And you, your servant you know.

en.L: What more can David add to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for the honor of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant? For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.B: What more can David say to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} about the honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have shown {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant? You know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.R: What more can I say to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} about the way {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have honored me? You know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.

es.L: ¿Qué más puede añadir David ante {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} por la honra de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo? Pues {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.B: ¿Qué más puede decirte David sobre la honra que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} le has dado a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo? Tú conoces a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.R: ¿Qué más puedo decirte sobre la manera en que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has honrado? Tú conoces a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.

fr.L: Que pourrait David {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dire de plus pour l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ? Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.B: Que pourrait David {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dire de plus sur l’honneur que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ? Tu connais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.R: Que puis-je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dire de plus sur la manière dont {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as honoré ? Tu connais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.

sw.L: Daudi aweza kukuongezea nini zaidi kwa ajili ya heshima ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}? Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unamjua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Daudi aweza kukuambia nini zaidi kuhusu heshima uliyompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}? Wewe unamjua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Niseme nini zaidi kwako kuhusu jinsi ulivyoniheshimu? Wewe unamjua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

vi.L: Đa-vít còn có thể thêm gì với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về sự tôn trọng dành cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Đa-vít còn có thể nói gì thêm với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về vinh dự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Ngài biết rõ đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Con còn có thể nói gì thêm với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về cách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tôn trọng con? Ngài biết rõ đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 다윗이 주님의 종의 영예에 대하여 주님께 무슨 말을 더 하겠습니까? 주님께서는 주님의 종을 아십니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 주님의 종에게 베푸신 영예에 대하여 다윗이 주님께 무슨 말씀을 더 드릴 수 있겠습니까? 주님께서는 주님의 종을 아십니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 저를 이렇게 높여 주셨는데, 제가 주님께 무슨 말씀을 더 드리겠습니까? 주님께서는 주님의 종을 잘 아십니다.

pt.L: Que mais Davi pode {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} acrescentar pela honra do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo? Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} conheces o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.B: Que mais Davi pode {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dizer sobre a honra que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} deste ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo? Tu conheces o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.R: Que mais eu posso {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dizer sobre a maneira como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me honraste? Tu conheces o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.

decisions.choice: What more can David add?: David speaks of himself by name
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:20. David names himself, as a servant might before his master. The question means he has nothing to add: God's gift goes beyond words.

decisions.choice: for the honor of your servant: the honor God has given David
decisions.reason: The honor is what God has done for David in the promise; David can add nothing to it.

decisions.choice: add ... for the honor of your servant
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:20 says "What more can David add to speak to you?" and ends with "my Lord Yahweh". Chronicles says "What more can David add to you for the honor of your servant?" and has no title at the end.

decisions.choice: you know your servant: you know me through and through
decisions.reason: To know a person can mean more than to be aware of him: to know him closely and to have chosen him (Genesis 18:19; Amos 3:2).

decisions.choice: say ... about the honor you have shown
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "add" means here, adding words, and whose honor it is.

decisions.choice: I
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:20: Readable says "I" for David's name, which in English would sound as if someone else were meant, and keeps "your servant" at the end.

source.text: יְהוָ֕ה בַּעֲב֤וּר עַבְדְּךָ֙ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַגְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את לְהֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת־כָּל־הַגְּדֻלּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh, for [the] sake of your servant and according to your heart you have done all the greatness the this, to make known all the great [things].

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} heart {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done all this greatness, to make known all the great [things].
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own heart chose, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done this great thing, to make all these great things known.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done this great thing for my sake and because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} wanted to. You have made all these great things known.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por amor a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} corazón has hecho toda esta grandeza, para dar a conocer todas las grandezas.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por amor a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y según lo quiso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propio corazón, has hecho esta gran obra, para dar a conocer todas estas grandezas.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho esta gran obra por amor a mí y porque así lo quisiste. Has dado a conocer todas estas grandezas.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} cœur, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait toute cette grande chose, pour faire connaître toutes les grandes [choses].
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propre cœur, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as accompli cette grande œuvre, pour faire connaître toutes ces grandes choses.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait cette grande chose à cause de moi et parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le voulais. Tu as fait connaître toutes ces grandes choses.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa ajili ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kwa kadiri ya moyo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} umefanya ukuu huu wote, ili kujulisha mambo yote makuu.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa ajili ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kama moyo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ulivyochagua, umefanya jambo hili kuu, ili kuyajulisha mambo haya yote makuu.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umefanya jambo hili kuu kwa ajili yangu na kwa sababu ulitaka hivyo. Umeyajulisha mambo haya yote makuu.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì cớ đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và theo lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm mọi điều lớn lao này, để cho biết mọi việc lớn lao.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì cớ đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và theo ý muốn của lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm việc lớn lao này, để tỏ ra mọi việc lớn lao ấy.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm việc lớn lao này vì con và vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn làm. Ngài đã cho mọi người biết những việc lớn lao này.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 종을 위하여, 그리고 주님의 마음대로 주님께서 이 모든 큰일을 행하셔서, 이 모든 큰일을 알게 하셨습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 주님의 종을 위하여, 주님의 뜻대로 이 큰일을 행하셔서, 이 모든 큰일을 알려 주셨습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 저를 위해서, 그리고 그렇게 하기를 원하셨기 때문에 이 큰일을 하셨습니다. 그리고 이 모든 큰일을 알려 주셨습니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, por causa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo e segundo o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} coração, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste toda esta grandeza, para dar a conhecer todas as grandes [coisas].
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, por causa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo e como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} próprio coração quis, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste esta grande coisa, para dar a conhecer todas estas grandes coisas.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste esta grande coisa por minha causa e porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} quiseste. Tu deste a conhecer todas estas grandes coisas.

decisions.choice: for your servant's sake; to make known all the great things
alternatives: for the sake of your word (2 Samuel 7:21)
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:21 has "for the sake of your word" and "to make it known to your servant". Chronicles has "for the sake of your servant" and "to make known all the great things", and it begins with the name, "Yahweh".

decisions.choice: according to your heart: as you yourself chose
decisions.reason: What Yahweh has done comes from his own will, not from anything David earned (compare 1 Samuel 13:14).

decisions.choice: this greatness ... the great things: great deeds
decisions.reason: The word means greatness, and here a great thing done: the promise of a lasting house. Its plural, "great things", is all that Yahweh has promised and made known.

decisions.choice: for my sake
decisions.reason: Readable says "my" for "your servant" (verse 17).

decisions.choice: LORD (when David speaks to him)
decisions.reason: As in verse 16.

decisions.choice: kwa ajili ya mtumishi wako (L, B); kwa ajili yangu (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "for the sake of your servant" where 2 Samuel 7:21 has "for the sake of your word"; the Swahili follows Chronicles.

decisions.choice: the vocative "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여" where David speaks to God by name
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 7:24 in Korean and the published Psalms: a name of God used in address takes -여.

decisions.choice: SENHOR, without the article in the vocative
decisions.reason: As in verse 16 and 2 Samuel 7:24 in Portuguese: when David speaks to the LORD by name, "SENHOR" / "Javé" has no article (verses 19, 20, 22, 23, 26, 27).

source.text: יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ין כָּמ֔וֹךָ וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים זוּלָתֶ֑ךָ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh, there is none like you, and there is no God except you, in all that we have heard with our ears.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, there is none like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and there is no God besides {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, there is no one like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and there is no God but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, as all we have heard with our own ears tells us.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, no one is like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. There is no God except {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Everything we have ever heard tells us so.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no hay nadie como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, y no hay Dios fuera de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, conforme a todo lo que hemos oído con nuestros oídos.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no hay nadie como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, y no hay Dios aparte de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, como nos lo dice todo lo que hemos oído con nuestros propios oídos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, nadie es como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. No hay Dios fuera de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Todo lo que hemos oído nos lo dice.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il n’y a personne comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et il n’y a pas de Dieu en dehors de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, d’après tout ce que nous avons entendu de nos oreilles.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, nul n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et il n’y a pas d’autre Dieu que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} : tout ce que nous avons entendu de nos propres oreilles nous le dit.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, personne n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Il n’y a pas d’autre Dieu que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Tout ce que nous avons entendu nous le dit.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, wala hakuna Mungu ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, kwa kadiri ya yote tuliyosikia kwa masikio yetu.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, wala hakuna Mungu ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, kama yote tuliyosikia kwa masikio yetu wenyewe yanavyotuambia.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. Hakuna Mungu ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. Kila kitu tulichowahi kusikia kinatuambia hivyo.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, không ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, theo mọi điều chúng con đã nghe tận tai.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, không ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đúng như mọi điều chúng con đã nghe tận tai.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, không ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mọi điều chúng con từng nghe đều cho thấy như vậy.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 우리가 우리 귀로 들은 모든 것대로, 주님 같은 이가 없고, 주님 외에는 하나님이 없습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 우리가 우리 귀로 들은 모든 것이 말해 주듯이, 주님 같은 분은 없고 주님 말고는 하나님이 없습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님 같은 분은 아무도 없습니다. 주님 말고는 하나님이 없습니다. 우리가 지금까지 들은 모든 것이 그렇게 말해 줍니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não há ninguém como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, e não há Deus além de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, segundo tudo o que ouvimos com os nossos ouvidos.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não há ninguém como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, e não há Deus além de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, como nos diz tudo o que ouvimos com os nossos próprios ouvidos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, ninguém é como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}. Não existe Deus além de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Tudo o que já ouvimos nos diz isso.

decisions.choice: there is none like you, and no God except you
decisions.reason: David uses the words of Israel's basic confession (Deuteronomy 4:35, 39) and of Hannah's prayer (1 Samuel 2:2).

decisions.choice: Yahweh, there is none like you
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:22 begins "Therefore you are great, my Lord Yahweh, for there is none like you". Chronicles begins simply "Yahweh" and goes straight to "there is none like you".

decisions.choice: all that we have heard with our ears: what has been told from generation to generation
decisions.reason: Israel knew Yahweh's deeds from what parents told their children (Psalm 44:2; Judges 6:13).

decisions.choice: LORD (when David speaks to him)
decisions.reason: As in verse 16.

source.text: וּמִי֙ כְּעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לִפְדּ֧וֹת ל֣וֹ עָ֗ם לָשׂ֤וּם לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֚ם גְּדֻלּ֣וֹת וְנֹרָא֔וֹת לְגָרֵ֗שׁ מִפְּנֵ֧י עַמְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר־פָּדִ֥יתָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם גּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And who [is] like your people Israel, one nation on the earth, whom went the God to redeem for himself [as] a people, to make for you a name [of] great [things] and awesome [things], by driving out from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt, nations?

en.L: And who [is] like {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel, one nation on the earth, whom God went to redeem for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} as a people, to make for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} a name [by] great and awesome [things], by driving out nations from before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} redeemed from Egypt?
en.B: Who is there like {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel, the one nation on earth that God went to redeem as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people? You made a name for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} by great and awesome deeds, driving out nations before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} redeemed from Egypt.
en.R: There is no nation on earth like {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel! God went to set them free so that they would be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people. You made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name famous by doing great and amazing things. You drove out other nations to make room for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set free from Egypt.

es.L: ¿Y quién [es] como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel, una nación en la tierra, a la que Dios fue a redimir para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} como pueblo, para hacerte un nombre [con] grandezas y [cosas] temibles, expulsando naciones de delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} redimiste de Egipto?
es.B: ¿Quién hay como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel, la única nación de la tierra que Dios fue a redimir como pueblo {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}}? Te hiciste un nombre con hechos grandes y temibles, expulsando naciones delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, al que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} redimiste de Egipto.
es.R: ¡No hay en la tierra otra nación como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel! Dios fue a liberarlos para que fueran {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo. Hiciste famoso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre con cosas grandes y asombrosas. Expulsaste a otras naciones para hacerle lugar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, al que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} liberaste de Egipto.

fr.L: Et qui [est] comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël, nation unique sur la terre, que Dieu est allé racheter pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme peuple, pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} faire un nom [par] des [choses] grandes et redoutables, en chassant des nations de devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as racheté d’Égypte ?
fr.B: Qui est comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël, la seule nation sur la terre que Dieu soit allé racheter pour en faire {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ? Tu {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es fait un nom par des actions grandes et redoutables, en chassant des nations devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as racheté d’Égypte.
fr.R: Aucune nation sur la terre n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël ! Dieu est allé le libérer pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Tu as rendu {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom célèbre en faisant des choses grandes et extraordinaires. Tu as chassé d’autres nations pour faire de la place à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as libéré d’Égypte.

sw.L: Na ni nani [aliye] kama watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli, taifa moja duniani, ambalo Mungu alikwenda kulikomboa kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mwenyewe kuwa watu, ili ujifanyie jina [kwa mambo] makuu na ya kutisha, kwa kufukuza mataifa mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, uliowakomboa kutoka Misri?
sw.B: Ni nani aliye kama watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli, taifa pekee duniani ambalo Mungu alikwenda kulikomboa liwe watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe? Ulijifanyia jina kwa matendo makuu na ya kutisha, ukiyafukuza mataifa mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, uliowakomboa kutoka Misri.
sw.R: Hakuna taifa duniani lililo kama watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli! Mungu alikwenda kuwaweka huru ili wawe watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. Ulilifanya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kuwa maarufu kwa kufanya mambo makuu na ya ajabu. Uliyafukuza mataifa mengine ili kuwapa nafasi watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, uliowaweka huru kutoka Misri.

vi.L: Có dân nào giống như dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như Y-sơ-ra-ên, một dân tộc trên đất mà Đức Chúa Trời đã đi chuộc về làm dân cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một danh [bằng những việc] lớn lao và đáng sợ, khi đuổi các dân tộc khỏi trước mặt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chuộc về từ Ai Cập?
vi.B: Có dân nào giống như Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân tộc duy nhất trên đất mà Đức Chúa Trời đã đi chuộc về làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Ngài đã làm cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được biết đến bằng những việc lớn lao, đáng sợ, đuổi các dân tộc khỏi trước mặt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chuộc về từ Ai Cập.
vi.R: Không có dân tộc nào trên đất giống như Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Đức Chúa Trời đã đi giải phóng họ để họ làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đã làm cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được lừng lẫy bằng những việc lớn lao và kỳ diệu. Ngài đã đuổi các dân tộc khác đi để nhường chỗ cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải phóng khỏi Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 땅 위에 있는 한 민족, 주님의 백성 이스라엘 같은 [민족이] 누구[입니까]? 하나님께서 가셔서 그들을 그분의 백성으로 구속하시고, 크고 두려운 [일들로] 주님을 위하여 이름을 내시고, 주님께서 이집트에서 구속하신 주님의 백성 앞에서 민족들을 쫓아내셨습니다.
ko.B: 땅 위에 주님의 백성 이스라엘 같은 민족이 또 어디 있겠습니까? 하나님께서 친히 가셔서 그들을 구속하여 그분의 백성으로 삼으셨습니다. 주님께서는 크고 두려운 일들로 이름을 떨치셨고, 이집트에서 구속하신 주님의 백성 앞에서 민족들을 쫓아내셨습니다.
ko.R: 땅 위에 주님의 백성 이스라엘 같은 민족은 없습니다! 하나님께서 가셔서 그들을 자유롭게 하시고 그분의 백성으로 삼으셨습니다. 주님께서는 크고 놀라운 일들을 하셔서 주님의 이름을 널리 알리셨습니다. 주님께서 이집트에서 자유롭게 하신 주님의 백성을 위해, 다른 민족들을 쫓아내셨습니다.

pt.L: E quem [é] como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel, uma nação na terra, a quem Deus foi resgatar para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} como povo, para fazer para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um nome [com] grandes e temíveis [coisas], expulsando nações de diante do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} resgataste do Egito?
pt.B: Quem há como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel, a única nação na terra que Deus foi resgatar para ser o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio povo? Tu fizeste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um nome com feitos grandes e temíveis, expulsando nações de diante do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} resgataste do Egito.
pt.R: Não há nenhuma nação na terra como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel! Deus foi libertá-lo para que fosse o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio povo. Tu tornaste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome famoso fazendo coisas grandes e maravilhosas. Tu expulsaste outras nações para abrir lugar para o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} libertaste do Egito.

decisions.choice: who is like your people ...?: Israel's unique story
decisions.reason: David echoes Moses: no other god ever went to take a nation for himself out of another nation, with signs and wonders, as Yahweh did for Israel in Egypt (Deuteronomy 4:7, 32-34; 33:29).

decisions.choice: redeem: set free from slavery
decisions.reason: The verb means to free someone by paying a price. It is used of Yahweh rescuing Israel from slavery in Egypt (Deuteronomy 7:8; 9:26).

decisions.choice: for himself ... for yourself: David turns from speaking of God to speaking to him
decisions.reason: David speaks of God in the third person ("God went to redeem for himself") and then turns to address him ("to make for yourself a name").

decisions.choice: driving out nations: the differences from 2 Samuel 7:23
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:23 is hard to read as it stands: it has a plural verb, "God (or gods) went", and "to do for you greatness and awesome things for your land, before your people ... nations and its gods". Chronicles has the singular verb, "for yourself a name", and "by driving out nations from before your people". It has no "for your land" and no "gods", and "whom you redeemed from Egypt" without "for yourself".

decisions.choice: [by] great and awesome [things]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words that join "a name" to the great deeds that made it.

decisions.choice: the question broken into shorter sentences
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break the long question into shorter sentences, and Readable turns the question into the statement it implies.

decisions.choice: resgatar (L, B), libertar (R); para ti um nome
decisions.reason: "Resgatar" and "libertar" as 2 Samuel 7:23 in Portuguese (m2). Chronicles has "for yourself a name" and no "for your land" or "their gods" (m4), so Portuguese follows it there, with the turn from "Deus ... para si" to "para ti" kept at Literal (m3).

source.text: וַ֠תִּתֵּן אֶת־עַמְּךָ֨יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל׀לְךָ֛ לְעָ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you made your people Israel for yourself as a people until forever, and you, Yahweh, have become for them as God.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel a people for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} forever, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, have become their God.
en.B: You made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own people forever, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, have become their God.
en.R: You made Israel {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own people forever. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, became their God.

es.L: E hiciste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel pueblo para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para siempre, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, has llegado a ser su Dios.
es.B: Hiciste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}} para siempre, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, has llegado a ser su Dios.
es.R: Hiciste de Israel {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propio pueblo para siempre. Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, llegaste a ser su Dios.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël un peuple pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour toujours, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es devenu leur Dieu.
fr.B: Tu as fait de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propre peuple pour toujours, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es devenu leur Dieu.
fr.R: Tu as fait d’Israël {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple pour toujours. Et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es devenu leur Dieu.

sw.L: Nawe umewafanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli kuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} milele, nawe, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umekuwa Mungu wao.
sw.B: Umewafanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli kuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwenyewe milele, nawe, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umekuwa Mungu wao.
sw.R: Umewafanya Israeli kuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} milele. Nawe, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukawa Mungu wao.

vi.L: Ngài đã lập dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm dân cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã trở nên Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.B: Ngài đã lập dân Y-sơ-ra-ên làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã trở nên Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên thành dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời. Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã trở nên Đức Chúa Trời của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 주님께서는 주님의 백성 이스라엘을 영원히 주님의 백성으로 삼으셨고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 그들의 하나님이 되셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 주님의 백성 이스라엘을 영원히 주님의 백성으로 삼으셨고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 그들의 하나님이 되셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 이스라엘을 영원히 주님의 백성으로 삼으셨습니다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 그들의 하나님이 되셨습니다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel um povo para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para sempre, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tornaste o Deus deles.
pt.B: Tu fizeste do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} próprio povo para sempre, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tornaste o Deus deles.
pt.R: Tu fizeste de Israel o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} próprio povo para sempre. E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tornaste o Deus deles.

decisions.choice: your people ... you have become their God: the covenant
decisions.reason: This is the covenant promise: "I will take you as my people, and I will be your God" (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12; Deuteronomy 29:12).

decisions.choice: you made
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:24 has "you established", the verb used for David's kingdom and throne. Chronicles has "you made" (literally "you gave" or "set"). Otherwise the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: LORD (when David speaks to him)
decisions.reason: As in verse 16.

decisions.choice: fizeste (L, B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "you made" where 2 Samuel 7:24 has "you established" (m2), so Literal and Balanced say "fizeste" for that Portuguese's "estabeleceste" / "firmaste"; the rest of the verse keeps its wording.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַל־בֵּית֔וֹ יֵאָמֵ֖ן עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Yahweh, the word that you have spoken about your servant and about his house, let be confirmed until forever, and do as you have spoken.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, let the word that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken concerning {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and concerning his house be confirmed forever, and do as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken.
en.B: And now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, let the word {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and about his house stand firm forever, and do as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have said.
en.R: So now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please keep forever the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made about me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, and about my family. Do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said.

es.L: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la palabra que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hablado acerca de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y acerca de su casa, sea confirmada para siempre, y haz como has dicho.
es.B: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que la palabra que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has dicho acerca de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y de su casa permanezca firme para siempre, y haz como has dicho.
es.R: Así que ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, te ruego que cumplas para siempre la promesa que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste acerca de mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, y de mi familia. Haz lo que dijiste.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que la parole que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcée au sujet de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et au sujet de sa maison soit confirmée pour toujours, et fais comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as parlé.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que la parole que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dite au sujet de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et de sa maison tienne pour toujours, et agis comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as dit.
fr.R: Alors maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, tiens pour toujours la promesse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faite pour moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, et pour ma famille. Fais ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit.

sw.L: Na sasa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, neno ulilosema kuhusu mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kuhusu nyumba yake na lithibitishwe milele, ukafanye kama ulivyosema.
sw.B: Basi sasa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, neno ulilosema kuhusu mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kuhusu nyumba yake na lisimame imara milele, ukafanye kama ulivyosema.
sw.R: Basi sasa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tafadhali itimize milele ahadi uliyotoa kuhusu mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, na kuhusu jamaa yangu. Fanya kama ulivyosema.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và về nhà người, xin làm cho [lời ấy] được vững lập đời đời, và xin làm như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và về nhà người được đứng vững đời đời, và xin làm như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giữ mãi mãi lời hứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và về gia đình con. Xin làm như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 주님의 종과 그의 집에 대하여 하신 말씀을 영원히 굳게 세우시고, 말씀하신 대로 행하십시오.
ko.B: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 종과 그의 집안에 대하여 하신 말씀을 영원히 이루어 주시고, 말씀하신 대로 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 종인 저와 제 집안에 대해 하신 약속을 영원히 지켜 주십시오. 말씀하신 대로 해 주십시오.

pt.L: E agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a palavra que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste a respeito do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo e a respeito da sua casa seja confirmada para sempre, e faze como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste.
pt.B: E agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, que a palavra que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disseste sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo e sobre a casa dele permaneça firme para sempre, e faze como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disseste.
pt.R: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, por favor, cumpre para sempre a promessa que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste sobre mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, e sobre a minha família. Faze o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disseste.

decisions.choice: let it be confirmed: let it prove true and stand firm
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the root that gives "amen" and "faithful": something that can be relied on to stand. David repeats it at the start of verse 24.

decisions.choice: do as you have spoken: prayer that holds Yahweh to his promise
decisions.reason: David asks only for what Yahweh has already promised. His prayer rests on Yahweh's word, not on his own wishes.

decisions.choice: Yahweh; let it be confirmed
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:25 has "Yahweh God" and "confirm it" (literally "make it stand"), asking Yahweh to act. Chronicles has "Yahweh" and "let it be confirmed", a verb from the root of "amen".

decisions.choice: the promise
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word here is: a promise.

decisions.choice: your servant (Literal, Balanced); me, your servant (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 17.

decisions.choice: seja confirmada (L), permaneça firme (B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles asks that the word "be confirmed" (m1, m3) rather than that God confirm it, so Literal and Balanced use a passive or intransitive verb; verse 24 repeats it.

source.text: וְ֠יֵֽאָמֵן וְיִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְךָ֤ עַד־עוֹלָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבֵית־דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדְּךָ֖ נָכ֥וֹן לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And let it be confirmed, and let be great your name until forever, saying, Yahweh of hosts, God of Israel, [is] God to Israel; and [the] house of David your servant [is] established before you.

en.L: And let it be confirmed, and may {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name be great forever, saying, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel, [is] God to Israel'; and the house of David {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant [will be] established before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Let it stand firm, and may {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name be great forever, as people say, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, is Israel's God!' And the house of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant David will stand firm before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Let it come true, so that people will honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever. They will say, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, truly is Israel's God!' And my family, the family of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant David, will stand firm in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence.

es.L: Sea confirmada, y sea engrandecido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre para siempre, diciendo: ‘{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, [es] Dios para Israel’; y la casa de David {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo [será] establecida delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Que permanezca firme, y que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre sea grande para siempre, y la gente diga: ‘¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, es el Dios de Israel!’. Y la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David permanecerá firme delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Que se cumpla, para que la gente honre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre para siempre. Dirán: ‘¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, es de verdad el Dios de Israel!’. Y mi familia, la familia de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David, permanecerá firme en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia.

fr.L: Qu’elle soit confirmée, et que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom soit grand pour toujours, et qu’on dise : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, [est] Dieu pour Israël” ; et la maison de David, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, [sera] affermie devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Qu’elle tienne, et que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom soit grand pour toujours, et que l’on dise : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, est le Dieu d’Israël !” Et la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur David sera ferme devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Qu’elle se réalise, pour que les gens honorent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour toujours. Ils diront : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, est vraiment le Dieu d’Israël !” Et ma famille, la famille de David, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, restera solide devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Na lithibitishwe, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} liwe kuu milele, kusema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, [ni] Mungu kwa Israeli'; na nyumba ya Daudi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [itakuwa] imeimarishwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Na lisimame imara, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} liwe kuu milele, watu wakisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, ni Mungu wa Israeli!' Nayo nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi itasimama imara mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Na litimie, ili watu waliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele. Watasema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, kweli ni Mungu wa Israeli!' Nayo jamaa yangu, jamaa ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi, itasimama imara mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Xin cho [lời ấy] được vững lập, và nguyện danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn đại đời đời, để người ta nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, [là] Đức Chúa Trời cho Y-sơ-ra-ên'; và nhà Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, [sẽ] được vững lập trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin cho lời ấy đứng vững, và nguyện danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn cao đời đời, khi người ta nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, là Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên!' Và nhà Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ đứng vững trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Xin cho lời ấy thành sự thật, để người ta tôn kính danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời. Họ sẽ nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, thật là Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên!' Và gia đình con, là gia đình Đa-vít đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ đứng vững trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 [그것이] 굳게 세워지고 주님의 이름이 영원히 크게 되어, '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님은 이스라엘의 하나님[이시다]' 하고 말하게 되기를 [원합니다]. 그리고 주님의 종 다윗의 집이 주님 앞에서 굳게 세워질 것입니다.
ko.B: 그 말씀이 굳게 서서 주님의 이름이 영원히 높아지고, 사람들이 '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님은 이스라엘의 하나님이시다!' 하고 말하게 해 주십시오. 그리고 주님의 종 다윗의 집안이 주님 앞에서 든든히 설 것입니다.
ko.R: 그 약속이 이루어지게 해 주십시오. 그러면 사람들이 영원히 주님의 이름을 높일 것입니다. 그들이 '하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님은 참으로 이스라엘의 하나님이시다!' 하고 말할 것입니다. 그리고 주님의 종 다윗의 집안, 곧 제 집안이 주님 앞에서 든든히 설 것입니다.

pt.L: E seja confirmada, e seja grande o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para sempre, dizendo-se: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, [é] Deus para Israel'; e a casa de Davi, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, [será] estabelecida diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Que ela permaneça firme, e que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome seja grande para sempre, quando o povo disser: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, é o Deus de Israel!' E a casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo Davi ficará firme diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Que ela se cumpra, para que as pessoas honrem o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para sempre. Elas vão dizer: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, é de verdade o Deus de Israel!' E a minha família, a família do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo Davi, ficará firme na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença.

decisions.choice: let it be confirmed, and may your name be great: a wish, with its result
decisions.reason: The verbs express a wish. When Yahweh keeps his word, his name will be honored and people will say who he is.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, is Israel's God
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:26 has "Yahweh of hosts is God over Israel". Chronicles has "Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, is God to Israel": the name people call him by will be proved true in what he does for Israel. Chronicles also begins with "let it be confirmed", repeating verse 23, and says "the house of David your servant".

decisions.choice: established: made firm
decisions.reason: The same word as in verse 14. David's house stands firm "before" Yahweh, in his presence and under his care.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (Literal); the LORD of Armies (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 7.

decisions.choice: truly is Israel's God
decisions.reason: Readable adds "truly" to bring out that the title will be shown to be true (m2).

decisions.choice: your servant (every level); my family (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 17.

decisions.choice: o SENHOR dos Exércitos (every level)
decisions.reason: As verse 7 and 2 Samuel 7:26 in Portuguese: "Exércitos" at every level. Readable adds "de verdade", as the English adds "truly" (m2).

source.text: כִּ֣י׀אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗י גָּלִ֨יתָ֙ אֶת־אֹ֣זֶן עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ בָּ֑יִת עַל־כֵּן֙ מָצָ֣א עַבְדְּךָ֔ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For you, my God, have uncovered [the] ear of your servant, to build for him a house; therefore has found your servant to pray before you.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, my God, have uncovered the ear of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, to build him a house; therefore {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant has found [courage] to pray before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, my God, have made it known to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will build him a house. That is why {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant has found the courage to pray before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: My God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have told me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will build a house for me, a family of kings. That is why I have been bold enough to pray to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Dios mío, has descubierto el oído de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, [diciéndole] que le edificarás una casa; por eso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo ha hallado [valor] para orar delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Dios mío, le has revelado a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo que le edificarás una casa. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo se ha atrevido a orar delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has dicho a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, que me edificarás una casa, una familia de reyes. Por eso me he atrevido a orar ante {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as découvert l’oreille de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, pour lui bâtir une maison ; c’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur a trouvé [le courage] de prier devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as révélé à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lui bâtirais une maison. Voilà pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur a trouvé le courage de prier devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as dit, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me bâtirais une maison, une famille de rois. C’est pourquoi j’ai osé {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} prier.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Mungu wangu, umelifunua sikio la mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kwamba utamjengea nyumba; kwa hiyo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} amepata [ujasiri] wa kuomba mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Mungu wangu, umemfunulia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwamba utamjengea nyumba. Ndiyo sababu mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} amepata ujasiri wa kuomba mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Mungu wangu, umeniambia mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kwamba utanijengea nyumba, yaani ukoo wa wafalme. Ndiyo sababu nimepata ujasiri wa kukuomba.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, đã mở tai đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [cho biết] sẽ xây cho người một nhà; vì thế đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới dám cầu nguyện trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, đã tỏ cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ xây cho người một nhà. Vì thế đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới đủ can đảm cầu nguyện trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ xây cho con một nhà, tức là một dòng dõi các vua. Vì thế con mới dám cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 나의 하나님, 주님께서 주님의 종의 귀를 여셔서 그에게 집을 세워 주시겠다고 [하셨습니다]. 그러므로 주님의 종이 주님 앞에서 기도할 [마음을] 얻었습니다.
ko.B: 나의 하나님, 주님께서 주님의 종에게 그의 집안을 세워 주시겠다고 알려 주셨습니다. 그래서 주님의 종이 용기를 내어 주님 앞에서 기도합니다.
ko.R: 나의 하나님, 주님께서는 주님의 종인 저에게 제 집안을 세워 주시겠다고, 왕들이 제 뒤를 잇게 하시겠다고 말씀해 주셨습니다. 그래서 제가 용기를 내어 주님께 기도합니다.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, meu Deus, descobriste o ouvido do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, para lhe edificar uma casa; por isso o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo achou [coragem] para orar diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, meu Deus, revelaste ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo que lhe construirás uma casa. É por isso que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo encontrou coragem para orar diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Meu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me disseste, a mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, que vais construir uma casa para mim, uma família de reis. É por isso que tive coragem de orar a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

decisions.choice: uncovered the ear: revealed
decisions.reason: To uncover someone's ear is to tell him something he did not know (1 Samuel 9:15; 20:2).

decisions.choice: my God; to build him a house; found to pray
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:27 has "Yahweh of hosts, God of Israel", quotes Yahweh's words "I will build a house for you", and says that David "has found his heart to pray this prayer to you". Chronicles has "my God", reports the promise ("to build him a house"), and says only that David "has found to pray before you".

decisions.choice: has found [courage]: found the boldness to pray
decisions.reason: The verb "found" has no object here. 2 Samuel 7:27 has "found his heart", that is, found courage, and that is the sense here: Yahweh's promise has given David the boldness to ask.

decisions.choice: [courage] (Literal); the courage (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced supply what David found (m3); Readable says "bold enough".

decisions.choice: a house, a family of kings
decisions.reason: As in verse 10, Readable adds what the house is, and says "me" and "I" for "your servant" and "him".

decisions.choice: descobriste o ouvido (L), revelaste (B); achou [coragem] (L), encontrou coragem (B)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 7:27 in Portuguese, with the changes of Chronicles (m2): "meu Deus", the promise reported ("para lhe edificar uma casa"), and "[coragem]" supplied for the verb that has no object here (m3). The "lhe" is David, so it has no deity_pronoun span.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אַתָּה־ה֖וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתְּדַבֵּר֙ עַֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֔ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Yahweh, you, he [is] the God, and you have spoken about your servant the good [thing] the this.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are God, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken this good [thing] to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.B: And now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are God, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have promised this good thing to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.R: Now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone are God. You have promised this good thing to me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.

es.L: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios, y has hablado a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo este bien.
es.B: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios, y le has prometido este bien a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.R: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios. Me has prometido este bien a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui es Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ce bien.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui es Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as promis ce bonheur à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.R: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es Dieu. Tu m’as promis ce bonheur, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.

sw.L: Na sasa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu, nawe umemwambia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [jambo] hili jema.
sw.B: Na sasa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu, nawe umemwahidi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} jambo hili jema.
sw.R: Sasa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke yako ndiwe Mungu. Umeniahidi mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, jambo hili jema.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán điều tốt lành này với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa điều tốt lành này với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời. Ngài đã hứa điều tốt lành này với con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 하나님이시고, 주님께서 주님의 종에게 이 좋은 [것을] 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.B: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 하나님이십니다. 주님께서 주님의 종에게 이 좋은 일을 약속하셨습니다.
ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님만이 하나님이십니다. 주님께서 주님의 종인 저에게 이 좋은 일을 약속하셨습니다.

pt.L: E agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és Deus, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo esta [coisa] boa.
pt.B: E agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és Deus, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prometeste esta coisa boa ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.R: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, só {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és Deus. Tu prometeste esta coisa boa a mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.

decisions.choice: you are God: you and no other
decisions.reason: The words, literally "you, he is the God", stress that Yahweh is the one true God (Deuteronomy 4:35; 1 Kings 18:39).

decisions.choice: this good thing: the promised blessing
decisions.reason: "Good" here is the good that Yahweh has promised: the lasting house (compare 1 Samuel 25:30).

decisions.choice: Yahweh; no "your words are truth"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 7:28 has "my Lord Yahweh" and adds "and your words are truth". Chronicles has "Yahweh" and does not have those words.

decisions.choice: LORD (when David speaks to him)
decisions.reason: As in verse 16.

decisions.choice: your servant (every level); me (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 17.
